agentic-loop.name: agentic-loop
agentic-loop.description: Universal pattern for autonomous agent workflow - the core observe -> plan -> act -> verify cycle that prevents hallucination, drift, and incomplete work.

asd-ste100.name: asd-ste100
asd-ste100.description: Enforce ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) specification rules for all technical documentation, Markdown files, and code comments with zero em dashes.

axi.name: axi
axi.description: Build and use agent-ergonomic CLI wrappers (AXI style) instead of MCP: TOON output, minimal schemas, truncation hints, total counts, empty states, structured errors, exit codes 0/1/2, and next-step hints. Load when wrapping a CLI for agents or choosing a tool interface.

backpass.name: backpass
backpass.description: Gradient descent for agent memory and instructions. Evaluates real agent session transcripts across harnesses, computes failure patterns, and proposes evidence-backed edits to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and skills under a strict token budget. Load when updating agent rules, pruning context drift, or auditing session failures.

code-review.name: code-review
code-review.description: Universal code review protocol for any language and any repository: five review dimensions (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance), severity triage (blocker/should/nit), and PR review workflow. Load when reviewing a diff, PR, or branch before merge.

context-engineering.name: context-engineering
context-engineering.description: Optimizes agent context window setup, token budget management, file indexing, and session memory across long-running tasks.

firstmate.name: firstmate
firstmate.description: Captain-and-crew orchestration distro: Captain, First Mate, Second Mates, and Crewmates; lifecycle (/ahoy, /bearings), backend selection (Herdr, tmux, Rex, cmux, Zellij, Orca, Paseo), Definition of Done, and stall or restart recovery. Load when coordinating agent fleets.

git-workflow.name: git-workflow
git-workflow.description: Commit signing (SSH), history purge, branch hygiene, and pre-commit universal guard for Monozen repos.

git-worktree.name: git-worktree
git-worktree.description: Create, use, and clean up isolated git worktrees so parallel agent tasks never share a working tree. Covers git worktree basics, treehouse pooled worktrees, pi-worktree wrapper, per-task isolation, merge back, and cleanup discipline. Load before spawning parallel subagents or parallelizing work.

grill-me.name: grill-me
grill-me.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

grilling.name: grilling
grilling.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

herdr.name: herdr
herdr.description: Operate the Herdr terminal multiplexer (0.9.x): named sessions, workspaces/tabs/panes, agent states, hooks, socket API, restart and husk behavior, and the captain-crew pattern. Load when running or supervising multiple agents in one workspace.

llm-as-verifier.name: llm-as-verifier
llm-as-verifier.description: Verification framework from the Stanford + NVIDIA LLM-as-a-Verifier paper (arXiv:2607.05391): continuous scores from expectation over scoring-token logits, score granularity, repeated evaluation, criteria decomposition, and the probabilistic pivot tournament for candidate ranking. Load when evaluating open-ended output, choosing the best of N candidates, or grading work that deterministic assertions cannot judge.

monozen-portfolio.name: monozen-portfolio
monozen-portfolio.description: Consolidated Monozen portfolio skill: dual-theme (Sun/Moon) lifecycle contracts, 5-panel SPA architecture, CSS specificity load order, WebGL context safety, nav capsule behavior, and pre-deploy audit protocol. Load when working on any file under the Monozen portfolio project.

new-project.name: new-project
new-project.description: Bootstrap any new software project from zero: repo creation, scaffold, constitution files (AGENTS.md, design.md, README.md), .gitignore, CI, signing, and first commit. Load whenever starting a new project or repository from scratch, for any language or stack.

no-mistakes.name: no-mistakes
no-mistakes.description: Run automated AI-driven validation pipelines and zero-slop PR creation through the no-mistakes local git proxy gate. Load when preparing to push branches, opening clean PRs, running pre-landing audits, or operating the no-mistakes TUI and headless AXI interface.

pi-agent.name: pi-agent
pi-agent.description: Configure and extend the Pi coding agent: extension API (terminal-title spinner, status), global settings.json, models.json provider overrides, and subscription-auth providers. Load when setting up Pi, writing a Pi extension, or tuning models/settings.

pr-workflow.name: pr-workflow
pr-workflow.description: Universal pull request lifecycle for any GitHub repo: branch strategy, PR creation, CI checks, review gate, merge (including protected branches), and cleanup. Load when opening, reviewing, or merging a PR, or pushing to a protected branch.

production-web-audit.name: production-web-audit
production-web-audit.description: Universal pre-deployment and release audit protocol for web applications: covers security headers & CSP, event/memory leak prevention, accessibility & reduced-motion compliance, Service Worker cache invalidation, automated test gates, and Chrome DevTools runtime validation. Use before deploying any web application to production.

prompt-engineering-loop.name: prompt-engineering-loop
prompt-engineering-loop.description: Lean iterative prompt refinement protocol - ELI10 structuring, clarifying questions, working examples, adversarial pressure testing, and verification-ladder stopping criteria for AI agent instructions.

skill-authoring.name: skill-authoring
skill-authoring.description: Meta-skill for authoring clean, runnable agent skill modules with frontmatter metadata, structured protocols, and zero em dashes.

task-decomposition.name: task-decomposition
task-decomposition.description: Breaks complex engineering requests into ordered, independent, testable sub-tasks with clear acceptance criteria.

test-driven-dev.name: test-driven-dev
test-driven-dev.description: Universal test-driven development protocol for any language or stack: write failing test first (red), minimal implementation (green), refactor, verify with real runtime evidence. Load when implementing any new feature, fixing a bug, or when a repo has no test-first discipline.
